title: Income Autopilot II: Testing the Muse
coreMove: Test the muse by asking strangers for buyer behavior before production; weak numbers are savings, not shame.

exampleSpecs.audience: a solo founder before buying inventory
exampleSpecs.stakes: Production cash may disappear before demand is tested.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use a pay-per-click landing page test before manufacturing.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Clever copy may hide a benefit buyers do not understand.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use ready fire aim to improve after market contact.

exampleSpecs.audience: a teacher pricing a digital product
exampleSpecs.stakes: Interest may vanish when the price becomes real.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Separate clicks from willingness to pay.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Boxes of unsold product may follow a fake validation test.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Treat a losing test as useful savings.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Friendly encouragement may be mistaken for demand.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use paid stranger traffic instead of survey approval.

exampleSpecs.audience: an analyst testing a paid research product
exampleSpecs.stakes: Changing too many parts may make the result unreadable.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Keep the test small enough to learn from.
